Reference / db/pool

db/pool#

A pool of database connections.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let pool = DbPool(
    origin: PostgresConnecting(…),
    options: PoolOptions(minimum: 2, maximum: 16, idle_timeout: Duration(seconds: (5 * 60).rat()),
        lifetime: Duration(seconds: (30 * 60).rat()), acquisition_timeout: Duration(seconds: 5.rat())),
    clock: SystemClock(),
);
let db = await pool.connection();
defer db.close();                       // returns it to the pool
await db.query("SELECT 1 AS one").one();

Description#

A pool of database connections.

A lease is a DbConnection. Closing it rolls back an open transaction, closes its cursors and statements, and returns the connection; a broken one is dropped. Connections idle longer than idle_timeout or older than lifetime are replaced (0 turns either off). A pool holds at most 64 connections. DbPreparedPool also hands out prepared statements and transactions.
